notes:
Settings are regrouped: General, Watching, Sources and discovery, Channels, Family and privacy, and App. Backup and restore has its own page, with Create and Restore joined in one button. Confirm before exiting moves to General. Remote control settings show on TV only. The More menu's description is plainer.

Selection outlines follow the shape of what's selected: settings rows and joined buttons no longer show square corners, and text fields no longer look double-outlined.

When a guide refresh doesn't work, the message says so in plain words and that the last guide is still in use.
